name: model-router
description: Routes each Claude Code turn to the cheapest model tier and effort that will get it right, using a local decision model, a cheap Claude classifier or a zero-cost heuristic, without throwing away a warm prompt cache.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: decision: a local decision model (LM Studio /v1/decisions) judges each prompt, nothing billed, prompt text stays on this machine. claude: a Claude model judges it. heuristic: keyword scoring only, instant and free. decision and claude fall back to heuristic when they cannot answer, so a turn is never left unrouted.

policy.title: Routing policy
policy.description: cache-aware: upgrade any time; downgrade only when the steps ahead repay rereading the chat at the cheaper model's cache-write price. always: switch whenever the classifier says so. effort-only: keep the model, tune effort. off: do nothing.

maxTier.title: Highest tier
maxTier.description: Caps the router so a prompt never goes above this tier.

maxEffort.title: Highest effort
maxEffort.description: Effort is capped here on every model that takes one.

reasoningModel.title: reasoning tier model
reasoningModel.description: Open-ended design; sent at effort high or above.

classifierModel.title: Claude classifier model
classifierModel.description: classifier = claude only. One short call per prompt.

coverage.title: Tier coverage
coverage.description: classifier = decision only: the cheapest tier whose cumulative probability reaches this. Higher is safer and dearer; 0 uses the model's top choice.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: After this much idle time a switch costs nothing extra.

expectedSteps.title: Expected steps per prompt
expectedSteps.description: Model requests a prompt is assumed to take when weighing a downgrade.

decisionLog.title: Decision log
decisionLog.description: One JSON file per routed turn, replayable with `model-router replay`. full: includes the ask (clipped). metadata: no prompt text. off: nothing written.
